Long, wavy honey-blonde hair with a side-parted fringe. Large, expressive pale-green eyes. Apparent age of early twenties with a sophisticated air. Slender, graceful build. A high-collared white blouse under a gold-trimmed cream waistcoat and a short, layered cream skirt. A small golden brooch pins a light-brown capelet around the shoulders.
BODY COLOR: fair porcelain
